theme: 3 terms on searching a list: the box, the object that manages it, and the callback that filters on each keystroke

terms.definition: A text box with a magnifying glass where the user types a search.

video.title: Search Bar, Search Controller & Search Results Updater | Day 109
video.description:
Learn to explain how live search is wired in UIKit: Search Bar, Search Controller & Search Results Updater, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Search Bar - A text box with a magnifying glass where the user types a search.
Search Controller - An object that manages the search bar and shows the results on top of your screen.
Search Results Updater - An object that gets called each time the search text changes, so it can filter the results.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.hook: Your search box does nothing. Can you explain why in English?

dialogue.title: The list never filters

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I added the Search Bar, but the list never changes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do you have a Search Controller?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, and it's in the navigation bar.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you set the Search Results Updater?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I don't think so. What does it do?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's called each time the text changes. You filter your notes there.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. The Search Controller calls it, and you read the text from the Search Bar.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So I set the Search Results Updater to `self`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Then each key press filters the list.
The Search Bar sits right under the title.
